narrative.overview:
The site has a technical spine and warm skin:
- **Structure is engineered.** A disciplined grid, generous white space, and mono section labels
  that read like code comments (`// 01 — O Que Fazemos`).
- **The surface is warm and responsive.** Cards lift when you reach for them, a soft blue light
  follows the pointer, buttons lean towards the cursor, and content rises into view as you
  scroll. The site should feel like a studio that answers back, which is what proximity looks
  like on screen.

Light, airy and confident:
- **Colour:** white and near-white surfaces, deep slate ink, and one saturated blue that carries
  every action and highlight.
- **Contrast:** a single dark panel (the closing CTA) gives each page its moment of contrast.
- **Motion:** lively and tactile by choice. It is always tied to an element's entrance, a state
  or the pointer, and every movement respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

It must never look like a corporate consultancy (stock photography, rigid navy, cold distance) or
a generic SaaS template (purple gradients, 3D icon packs, interchangeable sections).
keyCharacteristics: One accent: signal blue on white, slate for everything quiet.
Mono labels and `//` markers as the technical signature.
Rounded, bordered surfaces that respond to the pointer.
Motion everywhere, with purpose, and fully reduced when asked.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue with meaning. Actions, focus, selection and progress are blue; everything else is slate on white. Don't introduce a second accent colour for emphasis.

rules.name: The Legacy Names Rule
rules.body: In code, `proxio-darker` is white and `proxio-dark` is the light grey band. Use the tokens as they are and don't add raw hex values for the same colours.

rules.name: The Comment Marker Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows are mono, uppercase, tracked and prefixed with `//` and a two-digit index. Indices count the visible sections in order; when a section is hidden, renumber the rest.

rules.name: The Extra-Bold Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines are 800 weight with tight tracking. Don't set a headline in regular or light weight.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as the answer to hover, scroll or progress, and it is tinted blue or ink, never neutral black.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue (#2563eb) as the only accent: actions, focus, selection, progress.
Do open sections with the mono `// NN — Label` eyebrow, numbered in visible order.
Do set headlines in Plus Jakarta Sans 800 with tight tracking, and body text in slate muted.
Do make surfaces respond: Lift on card hover (`translateY(-4px)` plus a blue-tinted shadow), arrow nudges on CTAs, the magnetic pull on primary buttons for fine pointers.
Do pull every timing from the shared motion tokens (`src/lib/gsap.ts`), and give every animation a reduced-motion fallback that shows the final state.
Do use the existing tokens (`proxio-*`) instead of raw hex values.
donts: Don't drift towards a corporate consultancy look: no stock photography, no rigid navy palettes, no cold, distant layouts.
Don't fall into a generic SaaS template: no purple or rainbow gradients, no 3D icon packs, no interchangeable hero-features-pricing sections.
Don't add a second accent hue or neutral black shadows.
Don't add motion that loops for decoration on content areas. Idle loops are reserved for small illustrative accents (the orbit, the float).
Don't fill space with invented proof such as testimonials, client logos or metrics (see PRODUCT.md): an honest, shorter page beats a padded one.
